register_trainer: register a new RL training algorithm class with the baseline registry using a unique name key
get_trainer: get a previously registered RL training algorithm class from the baseline registry by its name
register_env: register a new RLEnv subclass environment with the baseline registry using a unique name key
register_policy: register a new RL policy class with the baseline registry using a unique name key
register_obs_transformer: register a new ObservationTransformer class with the baseline registry using a unique name key
